name: Conviction Gate
purpose: Block any real-money recommendation unless evidence is statistically credible and independently corroborated.

requiredGates.rule: validated historical sample meets per-game minimum and has no unresolved critical gaps
chronological out-of-sample backtest is positive after ticket costs
excess ROI versus reproducible random baseline is positive
lower confidence bound for excess ROI is > 0
sealed pre-draw Shadow Ledger is positive after a minimum evidence window
maximum drawdown stays within treasury risk limits
performance is stable across time windows and rule eras
all training and evaluation records are official-source validated

hardRules: No state is described as 100% guaranteed profit.
If any required gate fails, recommendedRealStake must be 0.
A model score cannot substitute for a probability of profit.
Positive historical results without out-of-sample confirmation do not qualify.
Human-readable UI must show the exact failing gates.
